discussion.key_messages: - High pressure will bring dry weather and near-seasonal temperatures across the area through Thanksgiving. - A more mild airmass will spread across the region for the upcoming weekend, boosting temperatures 5 to 10 degrees above normal for late November. - A weather system brushing by northern Utah late Friday will bring a chance of valley rain/mountain snow mainly north of I-80. - A more active weather pattern will return next week as a series of weather systems pass through the region. This far out, considerable uncertainty remains regarding the timing and track of these systems.
